# Team Africa Ventures

> Team Africa Ventures (TAV) is an operator-led venture studio based in Cape Town. It builds AI-first companies with founders: small teams, software doing most of the work, built to replace manual, people-heavy service businesses in markets worldwide.

## What TAV does
- Model: venture studio. TAV builds companies with founders from before day one, then funds what works.
- Stage: pre-idea through seed.
- Commitment: capital, a build team, an AI operating stack and a go-to-market network.
- Focus: AI-first replacements for incumbent service businesses (back-office services, customer operations, compliance and admin, commerce operations).
- Best for: founders and operators who know a service industry from the inside.

## Track record
- 18 companies built or backed, 8 exits, 1,000+ jobs created, $50m+ raised by its companies.
- Partners co-founded Twangoo, sold to Groupon 156 days after founding, and ran Groupon in South Africa for seven years.
- Companies built or backed have been acquired by Groupon, Naspers, Campaign Monitor, Massmart and Service Management Group (SMG).

## People
- Daniel Guasco, Partner
- Wayne Gosling, Partner
